start_description: Install the extension, add an UltralightView, and connect your game.
install_text: Download an extension package from Releases and extract it into your Godot project root. The manifest belongs at addons/ultralight-view/ultralight-view.gdextension.
requirements: Godot 4.3+ · Windows x86_64 / Linux x86_64 / macOS arm64
connect_text: Add an UltralightView with a nonzero size, register application APIs with UltralightAPI, and attach the registry to the View. Registrations are restored after navigation. C# requires the packaged csharp sources, Godot .NET and a compatible .NET SDK.
html_text: Save this page as ui/index.html in your project.
api_description: Find properties, methods and signals for page lifecycle, object bindings and rendering.
api_source_note: Reference content comes from the plugin’s Godot class documentation.
lifecycle_text: Load explicitly with load_url/load_html and wait for main-document dom_ready. frame_dom_ready also reports child frames. Registries install before window_ready and page scripts. Navigation, reload and rebuild invalidate old handles and unfinished tasks.
bridge_text: Containers are shared in both directions and nested values are wrapped lazily. Use evaluate_copy or snapshot for independent copies. C# helpers support public members, Task/ValueTask and collection adapters without [Export]. read_only restricts writes; members selects root members.
render_text: accelerated requests RenderingDevice; is_accelerated() reports the actual backend. Compatibility and headless fall back to CPU. Apply accelerated or transparent changes with rebuild(), which replaces the document.
fps_text: Ultralight Free caps View animations and repaints at 60 FPS. max_render_fps = 0 removes only the per-view limit, not the SDK edition ceiling.
